title.narrative: Comunicación feminista para un desarrollo real e inclusivo en Centroamérica

description.narrative: The new cycle of the project seeks to strengthen a renewed alliance between LatFem and grassroots feminist organisations to transform communication into a strategic, living and collective tool, rather than an operational burden. Based on its experience as a regional feminist media outlet and its previous work with We Effect, LatFem proposes to consolidate a sustained process that promotes profound cultural change around feminist communication, with an intersectional and territorial approach. The project is based on lessons learned from previous training and exchange experiences, which demonstrated both the potential and the limitations of virtual spaces. In this new stage, the aim is to ‘jump off the screen’ to strengthen presence, promoting dialogue, active listening and territorial relevance. This approach will allow feminist narratives to be anchored in specific communities, expanding LatFem's advocacy capacity beyond the digital sphere. It also seeks to regionalise and deepen the work of the Narrative Change team, consolidating LatFem as an organisation with regional political influence, especially in Central America, and linked to feminist and grassroots networks. The proposal also incorporates a thematic expansion, integrating the themes of care economy and access to housing into the communication agendas, in line with We Effect's regional priorities. This will make it possible to link feminist and climate struggles with fundamental social rights that are under dispute in Latin America. Finally, the project aims to strengthen its monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) mechanisms to more accurately measure the impact of actions, overcome the limitations of digital technology and ensure verifiable, sustainable and territorially traceable transformation processes.
